ITEM 1 | Pale yellow-green avocado slices, smooth flesh with slightly darker green skin edge, fanned in wedges about 6-8 cm long, lying on top of greens at upper left and center | 60
ITEM 2 | Dark green curly-edged leafy greens, mixed lettuce and spinach-like leaves with varied shades of green and some darker red-tinged leaf fragments, covering most of the bowl, matte and slightly moist | 90
ITEM 3 | Bright green broccoli florets, small clusters about 2-3 cm across, slightly glossy with fine stems, scattered at top and right of the bowl | 25
ITEM 4 | Cubed cooked white chicken pieces, opaque off-white with light golden browned edges, roughly 1.5-2.5 cm chunks with fibrous texture, scattered across the lower left and center | 65
ITEM 5 | Thin shaved pale yellow hard cheese shards, irregular flat slivers about 3-5 cm long with slightly translucent edges and a dry, matte surface, piled over the center and right side | 35
ITEM 6 | Small light tan crumbly fragments, possibly grated or chopped pale bits sitting among the greens near the center | 5
